reader.requirement: At --std 85 the CONTROL clause's operands, in written order, fix the hierarchy: FINAL (if written) highest, the first data-name major, later ones intermediate, the last minor, so control headings are processed major to minor and control footings minor to major, and a break at a level processes only that level and those below it.

edition-consulted.switches: bakes ctx.Data.DialectLevel into CobolReport.Edition, the argument every DialectBehaviors.IsActive question of the engine is asked with; the CONTROL registration (AddControl order, FINAL, image/float/collated arms) is edition-independent
DialectLevel < 2002 only: the 1985 SR2 distinct-control-items check (a syntax rule beside GR1, not the hierarchy itself)
DialectBehavior.GroupIndicateConsumedByIssuedGenerate (GROUP INDICATE consumed only by a presentation at 85); the break detection, save and CH/CF ordering beside it is one arm for every edition

reader.edition-search: grep DialectBehaviors.IsActive, Edition, DialectLevel over ReportWriter.cs, ReportWriterEmitter.cs and ReportSectionBinder.cs; the level numbering (ControlLevel = index in model.Controls, FINAL first) and the CH/CF loops take no edition

reader.notes: Levels are positional (index in model.Controls, FINAL index 0); DetectBreakLevel returns the most major changed level and GenerateCore/ProcessControlFootings run CFs from minor down to it and CHs from it to minor. The probes match the derivation for two and three levels, with and without FINAL.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XIII.3.7.4 GR1-GR4 and ReportWriter.cs GenerateCore/DetectBreakLevel/ProcessControlFootings (levels = index in _controls, FINAL index 0 and skipped by DetectBreakLevel). Probes at --std 85 under refute-1985-151/runs: r1fin (CONTROLS ARE FINAL KA KB KC with CH only for FINAL and KC, CF only for KB and FINAL; plus RD S CONTROL IS FINAL alone): minor change -> CHC only; major change -> CFB (prior values AAB, SUM 003) then CHC; intermediate change -> CFB then CHC; TERMINATE CFB, CFF 010; report S: SCH, SDT x4, SCF 010 - all as derived. r1grp (group control KG with a fixed OCCURS 3 subordinate, minor to KM): change of KE(2) breaks at KG only; KM change -> CFG CFM CHM CHG. r1finord (CONTROLS ARE KA FINAL ...) refused COBOL2421; r1finsub (subscripted operand) refused COBOL1699. cite: OK  §1985:XIII.3.7.4 GR1  (3.7.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1.
